recovery_regressions: Execution approval blocks stop executor, reviewer and repair without alternate dispatch; repeated run preserves terminal result.
Failed method controls remain distinct from candidate integrity failures and unresolved evidence.
Method settings, assembly applicability and current evaluation-plan bindings are required before structural promotion.
Mismatched or absent poll identities cannot replace the original jobs or promote returned artifacts.
Saved polling receipts undergo the same identity checks after restart.
An execution-approval timeout while polling cannot erase outstanding remote handles.
Evidence invalidation archives old structure/chemistry exports and empties the current qualified FASTA; unchanged exports are idempotent.
policy_update_scope: Execution policy 1.1 requires bound execution artifacts and checks declared routes, receipts and raw-output hashes. Fresh runs isolate current intent and environment. Hosted readiness uses service contracts without requiring private model internals. Existing fold contract 2.1 is unchanged. No scientific inference or live provider enforcement was tested.
fold_admission_regressions: Ordinary generation without assessment models cannot advance in either tool-selection condition, even with reviewer acceptance.
Preparation-only evidence cannot pass independent fold assessment.
Empty/malformed models, missing or failed method controls and missing integrity review are rejected.
Saved acceptance without required model records is invalidated before downstream dispatch.
Downstream assessment and final qualification require current accepted fold evidence.
Qualified export cannot fall back to generated coordinates.
Valid synthetic monomer and full homodimer model records pass the same admission contract.
execution_policy_regressions: Agent-selected and prescribed conditions receive distinct frozen execution policies and instruction paths.
Changing a saved policy or condition prevents dispatch.
After a simulated shared-Markdown update, the copied controller still passes offline doctor checks with the original run policy.
A completed scientific stage without execution records is not accepted or advanced to sequence screening.
Forbidden declared routes, stale policy/candidate bindings, missing outputs, and support-only prediction claims are rejected.
Synchronous invocations work without invented job IDs; chemistry and prescribed-tool exceptions require their evidence bindings.
Permitted deterministic state construction can use support scripts without claiming a prediction.

regressions: Required user-property criteria cannot be omitted, weakened or replaced by a different endpoint.
Each active site requires a directed reactant-to-product chemical path before profile qualification.
Hosted service provenance is accepted without fictitious code commits; captured dates are validated without optional date-time dependencies.
Empty receipts, captured invocations and chemistry-exception evidence, and wholly empty raw outputs, are rejected.
Ambiguous PDB numbering/alternate locations and multiple models are rejected before local preparation.
Undefined geometric measurements cannot be misclassified as cis peptide geometry.
other_fixes: Freeze per-site catalytic map identity at final qualification
Clarify template-free assessment and cis-Pro preparation scope
Distinguish reportable partial outcomes from successful qualification
